title: Undispense
subtitle: Undispenses waiting to be sent or failed, so a returned authorization can be dispensed at another store. Retry a failed one, or undispense one authorization whose invoice is fully returned.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not have access to the Nphies screens. Ask an administrator to grant it.
access.unreachableHint: The access check did not answer. Try again in a moment.

list.failed: The undispenses could not be read. Try again in a moment.
list.truncated: Only the newest 500 are shown. Narrow the filters to see the rest.

retry.doneDetail: The undispense of {{authId}} is pending again and will be sent shortly.

manual.label: Undispense one authorization
manual.hint: Only when its invoice is fully returned, on either till.

outcome.queuedDetail: The undispense of {{authId}} is queued and will be sent shortly.
outcome.alreadyPendingDetail: An undispense of {{authId}} for this return is already waiting to be sent. Nothing new was queued.
outcome.alreadyFailedDetail: An undispense of {{authId}} for this return already exists and failed. Retry it from the list.
outcome.alreadyDoneDetail: {{authId}} was already undispensed for this return. Nothing new was queued.

dialog.title: Undispense authorization
dialog.body: Undispense authorization {{authId}}? Its dispensed mark is cleared, so another store can dispense it. Your name and the note are recorded.
dialog.notePlaceholder: Why is this authorization being undispensed?
dialog.noteRequired: Type a note first — every undispense is logged with its reason.

refusals.invoiceNotFound: Head office holds no completed sale under this authorization, so it cannot be undispensed here.
refusals.notFullyReturned: The invoice is not fully returned. Every item of the sale must be returned before the authorization can be undispensed.
refusals.noteRequired: A note is required to undispense an authorization.
refusals.noGrant: You do not hold the grant to undispense. Ask an administrator.
refusals.retryNotFound: This undispense no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
refusals.retryNotFailed: This undispense is not failed any more — it is pending or done. The list has been refreshed.
refusals.stateInvalid: The state filter was not understood. Reset the filters and try again.
